Abstract.AbstractText: We describe the generation of a biallelic GBA deletion human embryonic stem cell line using zinc finger nuclease-mediated gene targeting. The homozygous targeting of exon 4 of the GBA locus leads to a complete loss of glucocerebrosidase (GCase) protein expression.
